description: Create a new .docx Word document from markdown or plain text content. Supports headings (#, ##, ###), bold (**text**), italic (*text*), bullet lists (- item), numbered lists (1. item), and blank lines between paragraphs.

author.description: Author name stored in document metadata

content.description: Document body content as markdown. Supports headings (#, ##, ###), bold (**text**), italic (*text*), bullet lists (- item), and numbered lists (1. item).

outputPath.description: Absolute or relative path where the .docx file will be saved (e.g., /tmp/report.docx)

title.description: Document title — appears as the document heading

name: create_document
